problem: The full public-page browser sweep intermittently failed on a single Netlify deploy-preview route with HTTP 403 while surrounding routes and viewports remained healthy.
root_cause: The visibility check treated deploy-preview traffic with the same short three-attempt retry window as production, even though Netlify preview infrastructure can transiently return 403 under a large route sweep.
decision: Keep production strict at three attempts, but give deploy-preview URLs five bounded attempts with increasing backoff. Persistent 403 responses still fail closed.
prevention: Deploy-preview transient 403/429/5xx responses receive a bounded five-attempt retry budget.
Production keeps the original three-attempt budget.
Non-transient HTTP failures still stop immediately.
A persistent 403 still fails the browser contract.
